design_registry.title: R01 Original creator drawing
design_registry.approved_scope: Original cap-and-bob relationship, pale-green body, pink skirt, dark waistband, lantern and three characteristic poses.
design_registry.known_defects: Original feet and lower-leg bands predate the explicitly selected pointed-leg revision. Do not reinstate them. The later written cap rule supersedes its higher crown.

design_registry.title: R02 First detailed interpretation
design_registry.approved_scope: Early glassy-white eyes, cap gills and translucent fungal-material exploration.
design_registry.known_defects: Conventional feet, humanized face and visible surface anatomy are not a final specification.

design_registry.title: R03 Early sheet with conventional feet
design_registry.approved_scope: Early mouth/eye and cap-material studies.
design_registry.known_defects: Feet and lower-leg bands are superseded; some internal branching is strongly geometric.

design_registry.title: R04 Early pointed-leg variant
design_registry.approved_scope: Move from feet toward pointed lower limbs.
design_registry.known_defects: Contact growth is not resolved and the internal network is too node-like for the later direction.

design_registry.title: R05 First branching-contact exploration
design_registry.approved_scope: Visible branching at ground contact rather than merely touching the ground.
design_registry.known_defects: Do not copy thicker radial strands, permanent root-like silhouettes or body proportions wholesale.

design_registry.title: R06 Long-lichen exploration
design_registry.approved_scope: Development history of lichen as the hair material.
design_registry.known_defects: Long hanging growth and enlarged fronds were explicitly corrected. This is not a hair-length reference.

design_registry.title: R07 Compact-lichen revision
design_registry.approved_scope: Return to a compact dark bob with finer lichen detail.
design_registry.known_defects: Some areas still read as ordinary hair decorated with lichen; later texture and colour instructions are more specific.

design_registry.title: R08 Selected proportions and lichen
design_registry.approved_scope: Primary proportional reference for long narrow legs and the selected texture/feel of the compact lichen bob.
design_registry.known_defects: Do not copy absent contact growth, bright geometric hyphae, cap crown height or mislabeled detail panels. This approval was feature-specific.

design_registry.title: R09 Root-like contact failure
design_registry.approved_scope: Failure reference: the point and gripping network merge visually.
design_registry.known_defects: Do not adopt its root-like terminations or treat the captioned step sequence as proof the mechanism is correct.

design_registry.title: R10 Initial isolated locomotion study
design_registry.approved_scope: Approach/touch panels begin separating the clean point from external hyphae.
design_registry.known_defects: Hero legs still suggest feet/heels; other panels have high-origin strands. Later geometry takes priority.

design_registry.title: R11 Continuous-point geometry study
design_registry.approved_scope: Continuous terminal taper and the separation between the intact point and lateral contact growth.
design_registry.known_defects: Creator requested thinner calves and the proportions of R08. Sprouting height and filament thickness must still be checked against the written rule.

design_registry.title: R12 Thin-calf combination
design_registry.approved_scope: Combines a long slim taper with contact studies and the established bob.
design_registry.known_defects: Bright nodes and angular internal branches were subsequently challenged. Cap shape is subject to the later written revision.

design_registry.title: R13 Reduced-constellation revision
design_registry.approved_scope: Attempt to reduce decorative glowing-node treatment after the explicit hyphae correction.
design_registry.known_defects: Residual straight segments and bright junctions remain. Its captions are not evidence that all corrections succeeded.

design_registry.title: R14 Initial animation sheet
design_registry.approved_scope: Development layouts, pose range and first animation-sheet organisation.
design_registry.known_defects: Some expressions were rejected as off-model. A capless head study does not establish a detachable cap.

design_registry.title: R15 Restrained-acting revision
design_registry.approved_scope: Head angle and hand gestures used to support expression.
design_registry.known_defects: Still includes conspicuous nodes and some humanized mouth details. Not a blanket-approved acting or anatomy sheet.

design_registry.title: R16 Expression-only study
design_registry.approved_scope: Head orientation, hand placement, quiet attention and restrained expression as a direction.
design_registry.known_defects: Some smiles and the speaking-mouth inset exceed the tiny seam. Approve individual poses, not the whole sheet.

design_registry.title: Locomotion Reference - Step Cycle
design_registry.approved_scope: Six-stage organisation, isolated lower-leg studies and substrate examples.
design_registry.known_defects: The release image retains hanging filaments; the final airborne state must instead be clean. Some webs are too thick or radial. Crops do not fix these defects.

design_registry.title: Locomotion Reference - Movement and Surfaces
design_registry.approved_scope: Terrain-following branches and examples of locomotion used in poses.
design_registry.known_defects: Do not copy bulkier legs, root-like contact fans, persistent release strands or a changed cap shape.

design_registry.title: R19 Rejected-cap turnaround
design_registry.approved_scope: Failure reference for inconsistent head/body rotations and cap geometry.
design_registry.known_defects: The taller conical cap and changed patch density were challenged. Do not promote this sheet as a canonical turnaround.

design_registry.title: R20 Supplied material and pose interpretation
design_registry.approved_scope: Further surface-filament, hand, material and pose examples supplied for consolidation.
design_registry.known_defects: Ordinary hair-like locks, humanized face/surface anatomy and calf volume vary from the settled rules.

design_registry.title: R21 Supplied thin-calf sheet variant
design_registry.approved_scope: Another available copy of the thin-calf combination and the long taper.
design_registry.known_defects: Retains constellation-like junctions and earlier cap shape. Separate supplied file, not a separate approval.

design_registry.title: R22 Supplied point-geometry sheet variant
design_registry.approved_scope: Continuous-point anatomy and contact sequence in the supplied copy.
design_registry.known_defects: Calf thinning and lower contact-zone refinements still apply. Separate supplied file, not a separate approval.

design_registry.title: R23 Supplied alternate design sheet
design_registry.approved_scope: Additional gill, hand, surface and turnaround layout examples.
design_registry.known_defects: The joyful expression opens into a conventional smile; some leg and cap shapes differ. Do not inherit these as changes to canon.

design_registry.title: Top Level Reference Sheet
design_registry.status: Creator-praised overview; subsequent tissue-depth correction applies.
design_registry.approved_scope: Overview organisation, feature coverage and the visual direction the creator praised. Retain only individually suitable details.
design_registry.known_defects: The subsequent request specifically challenges the painted-on internal network. Do not inherit calf bulk, a high cap crown, additional human-specific surface detail, lip volume or persistent release strands. General praise is not a geometry/material approval of every panel.

design_registry.title: Deep-Hyphae Reference Sheet
design_registry.status: Subsurface-depth revision attempt; ranked overview candidate, not approved final anatomy.
design_registry.approved_scope: Consolidated overview coverage, glassy eye detail, gill structure, and comparison of the tissue-depth attempt against the written brief.
design_registry.known_defects: The title does not establish successful subsurface depth. The network remains too uniformly legible in several areas; calf volume, cap/patch continuity, lip-like seam edges, human-specific surface details and attached release strands require correction.

design_registry.title: Rendered three-pose sheet
design_registry.status: Creator-supplied supporting style/pose reference; no blanket design approval.
design_registry.approved_scope: A rendered treatment of the lantern-and-raised-knee pose, standing pointing pose and seated backward glance. Use for composition, gestures and an optional luminous/wet material presentation.
design_registry.known_defects: The visible lower-leg bands, prominent pointed ears, longer hanging hair details, bright angular/node-like hyphae and water droplets are not newly approved design features. This image does not establish subsurface filament depth, a final cap profile or default translucency for the skirt.

design_registry.title: Soft-shaded three-pose sheet
design_registry.status: Creator-supplied supporting style/pose reference; no blanket design approval.
design_registry.approved_scope: A softer shaded interpretation of the same three poses, with quieter surface detail and a compact bob. Useful for comparing pose readability and broad colour masses without a detailed forest background.
design_registry.known_defects: Simplified lichen, faint internal structure and absent contact-growth detail are presentation choices, not removals from Myca's design. Use the written cap, calf and clean-point rules rather than treating this page as a measured model or completed locomotion study.

design_registry.title: Flat-colour three-pose sheet
design_registry.status: Creator-supplied supporting style/pose reference; no blanket design approval.
design_registry.approved_scope: A clean line-and-flat-colour interpretation of the lantern, pointing and seated poses. Useful for silhouette, gesture, large colour areas and comparison with the original three-pose composition.
design_registry.known_defects: The omission of visible internal hyphae, detailed lichen, glassy material response and contact filaments is a simplification, not a canon change. Do not substitute its proportions, cap crown or pointed-leg geometry for the established feature-specific references.

design_registry.title: Gill-frill, veil-streamer and spore-lace explorations
design_registry.approved_scope: The distinct structural ideas of (1) radially pleated gill-frill membrane, (2) long open veil-streamer ribbons, and (3) fenestrated spore-lace membrane.
design_registry.known_defects: Generated captions, exact pore placement, decorative spore glow, cap/face drift, or any accidental textile-like fastening. The three concepts remain separate candidates; do not average them together.
design_registry.original: `myca_fungal_membrane_explorations.png` · 1122 × 1402 pixels. Added as preserved experimental reference on 10 October 2026.

design_registry.title: Shelf-fungus membrane exploration
design_registry.approved_scope: Layered bracket/shelf architecture, scalloped tier edges and a more substantial semi-rigid fungal skirt replacement.
design_registry.known_defects: Exact number of shelves, generated pores/gills, incidental contact web, cap/face/body drift or any human-specific anatomy. Shelf-fungus layering is the tested feature.
design_registry.original: `myca_fungal_being_concept_sheet.png` · 1122 × 1402 pixels. Added as preserved experimental reference on 10 October 2026.

design_registry.title: Four additional membrane candidates summary
design_registry.approved_scope: Side-by-side visual distinction between gill-frill, veil-streamer, spore-lace and shelf-fungus membrane candidates.
design_registry.known_defects: Generated explanatory text as authority, exact decorative details, garment-like seams, cap/body drift or any feature outside the four membrane architectures. Use R32/R33 plus the written module when precise construction matters.
design_registry.original: `myca_fungal_membrane_explorations.png` · 1122 × 1402 pixels. Added as preserved experimental comparison on 10 October 2026.

design_registry.title: Selected leg proportions
design_registry.crop_scope: Leg length, reduced lower-leg width and continuous pointed silhouette only. The earlier cap and filament treatment are not approved by this crop.

design_registry.title: Selected lichen texture
design_registry.crop_scope: Compact bob and small lichen structure. Ignore bright facial nodes and do not infer new facial anatomy.

design_registry.title: Uninterrupted terminal geometry
design_registry.crop_scope: One clean lower-leg taper. This is a geometry detail, not a full-body proportion guide.

design_registry.title: Initial contact
design_registry.crop_scope: Intact point at first contact. Use written low-origin rule for subsequent emergence.

design_registry.title: Lateral hyphal emergence
design_registry.crop_scope: Distinction between point and lateral filaments. The visible emergence zone should be tightened to immediately above the substrate.

design_registry.title: Clean airborne release
design_registry.crop_scope: Clean point after release. Any residual substrate filaments are separate from the lifted leg.

design_registry.title: Organic hand filaments
design_registry.crop_scope: Supporting internal-material study. Not approval of hand topology or every visible branch shape.

design_registry.title: Terrain-following contact
design_registry.crop_scope: Branches following leaves, moss, wood and stones. Reduce thickness and regularity where required by the locomotion specification.

design_registry.title: Standing body and leg mass
design_registry.crop_scope: Body mass and existing clean pointed endings only. Cap and part of the gesture are deliberately outside the crop. Slim the calves to the selected proportional target; this is not a measured or complete turnaround.

design_registry.title: Cap overhang and compact bob
design_registry.crop_scope: Broad head-to-cap relationship and compact bob mass. The crown, patch map, exact face and lichen construction remain subject to the written brief; this crop is not all-angle cap approval.

design_registry.title: Selected paired leg tapers
design_registry.crop_scope: Selected leg-length and taper relationship. This narrow crop excludes the earlier cap and printed annotations. Visible angular internal lines are not approved; upper-leg volume hidden by the skirt is not inferred.

design_registry.title: Selected lichen macro
design_registry.crop_scope: Selected lichen texture and small overlapping growth. The dark-edge / pale-interior relationship is still controlled by the written brief. A macro alone does not establish hair length.

design_registry.title: Glassy white eye detail
design_registry.crop_scope: Pearlescent unmarked eye volume only. Do not copy precise eyelash, eye-rim or surrounding facial topology as newly approved anatomy.

design_registry.title: Tissue depth comparison
design_registry.crop_scope: Comparison-only material attempt. It does not yet settle convincing layered depth and must not be used as a finished texture target.

design_registry.title: Internal hand filaments without caption
design_registry.crop_scope: Fine irregular hand/wrist filaments as an organic-material donor. Fingertips and the old caption are excluded; this does not approve hand topology or prove final subsurface depth.
